Use parameterized query to prevent SQL injection # We use utcnow().isoformat() to ensure consistent date-time strings timestamp = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() conn.execute('INSERT INTO clicks (timestamp) VALUES (?)', (timestamp,)) conn.commit() return jsonify({"message": "Click registered successfully"}), 201 except Exception: #
